name: barbell-side-lunge.html
instructions:
1. Set up with your feet shoulder width apart and a barbell resting across your traps.
2. Step laterally with your trail leg extended and descend until the thigh is parallel with the floor.
3. Drive through the weight bearing leg and extend the knee as you push back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
